messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday when it falls on a weekend) and is surrounded by at least one weekend day.  

| Date(s) (2023) | Holiday | Notes |
|----------------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed on Monday Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday, so the statutory holiday is observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Family Day is on Monday Feb 20. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is on Friday Apr 7; the weekend follows. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is on Monday May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed on Monday Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday, so the statutory holiday is observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday Nov 13) | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday, so the statutory holiday is observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is on Monday Dec 25. |
| **Dec 24–26** | Boxing Day | Boxing Day is on Tuesday Dec 26; the weekend precedes it. |

> **Tip for your app** – If you need to support all provinces, remember that some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.) vary by province. The table above lists the federal holidays that create long weekends nationwide. For province‑specific holidays, you’ll need to add the relevant dates per province.
